Decision: MAYBE. The paper's main method is a persistent optimization memory for EDA tuning, not clearly a RAG system. Its abstract does mention an LLM+RAG baseline in the experiments, so it compares against RAG. Whether the memory itself counts as retrieval-augmented generation is unclear, because the memory is shared between candidate generation and budget allocation and is read back into the LLM. Since the rules say to mark MAYBE when unsure, I'm choosing that rather than excluding on E1.
